anti_convergence_rule: If a function test turns into validator/checklist hardening without showing its Phase1 stage attachment, stop and backlog it for Phase3.
phase2_session_rule: Every Phase2 function test must output: tested_function, attached_phase1_stage, observed_gap, proposed_fix_or_watch, phase3_backlog_delta, next_test_candidate.
principle: Phase1 = whole-flow rehearsal. Phase2 = function placement/testing against whole-flow stages. Phase3 = revise using accumulated Phase2 observations, not one-by-one patches.
